Salem is not a city where buyers ask vague questions. A procurement manager at a steel plant vendor or a construction contractor setting up a site office near SIPCOT Mecheri knows exactly what they need — a wired, lockable, weather-proof cabin that is on-site fast and does not require a civil contractor to install.

That is what SAMAN makes. We are an ISO-certified manufacturer of MS-frame steel porta cabins based in Bangalore. Our Gopasandra facility (560099) builds to order and dispatches directly to Salem — no dealer, no reseller, no assembly at your site. Salem is approximately 340 kilometres from our factory via NH 44 through Krishnagiri. Transit time to your address is typically 4 to 5 days from dispatch.

Browse our porta cabins or call us directly with your size and use — we quote the same day.

Salem's Industrial Profile and Where Porta Cabins Fit

Salem punches well above its city-tier in industrial output. Three sectors drive consistent demand for site offices and security structures here:

Salem Steel Plant (SAIL): One of India's few special steel plants, the Salem Steel Plant complex runs continuous production and has an active vendor and contractor ecosystem. Construction work on plant upgrades, service buildings, material yards, and township infrastructure creates ongoing demand for temporary site offices, watchman cabins, and labour rest rooms.

SIPCOT Mecheri Industrial Complex (PIN 636453): Located about 32 kilometres from Salem city on the Mettur Road, this industrial estate hosts engineering units, chemical plants, and manufacturing companies. New unit construction and existing unit expansion inside SIPCOT Mecheri is consistent. Site offices for project contractors here are a recurring need.

Textile and engineering belt: Salem district has a significant textile machinery and power loom industry. Warehouse and production unit construction along the Salem–Erode–Coimbatore NH 544 corridor adds to site-office demand across the district.

A buyer in Salem choosing between a local dealer and a direct manufacturer should know one thing: the dealer buys from a manufacturer like us and adds a margin. We are the source.

What We Build and the Sizes We Deliver to Salem

Every cabin starts as a mild steel frame. IS 2062 grade hollow sections, cut to length, welded at our Bangalore factory, primed and treated before panels go on. The frame is the structure. Everything else — panels, roof, floor, doors, windows, fit-out — is built around it.

  • Frame: IS 2062 MS hollow sections, factory-welded, anti-rust primed
  • Panels: 40mm PUF sandwich panel (thermal insulation) or cement fibre board
  • Roof: GI sheet with anti-corrosion coating, heat-reflective finish
  • Floor: Anti-skid chequered steel sheet or plywood-over-MS frame
  • Doors: MS single or double leaf, or painted wooden door with lock
  • Windows: Sliding glass, fixed louvre vent, or mesh window — one type or mixed

Standard sizes dispatched to Salem:

SizeTypical use
10 ft × 8 ftWatchman cabin, tool store, pump room
12 ft × 8 ftSupervisor office, sample inspection room
20 ft × 8 ftWired contractor site office
20 ft × 10 ftLarger site office with partition option
40 ft × 8 ftLabour rest room, long storage unit

Custom sizes built on request. If your site has a non-standard footprint, send us the dimensions and we design to fit.

Customisation Options

Salem's climate matters here. Inland Tamil Nadu summers push temperatures that make a poorly insulated cabin uncomfortable and reduce productivity. We address this before the cabin leaves our factory, not after.

What you can specify:

  • Insulation upgrade: Standard 40mm PUF or thicker PUF for direct-exposure sites. Reduces internal temperature significantly.
  • Heat-reflective roof: GI sheet with reflective coating reduces radiant heat gain — standard on all our Salem-bound cabins, not an add-on.
  • Electrical fit-out: Single-phase wiring from entry point, MCB board, switch sockets, LED light fittings, fan point.
  • AC provision: Cut-out in panel, bracket mounting, copper pipe sleeve, drain outlet — ready for you to fit your own AC unit on arrival.
  • False ceiling: Plywood or PVC panel, reduces dead air volume and helps cooling efficiency.
  • Doors and windows: Number, position, and type confirmed before production.
  • Toilet module: FRP water tank, flush commode, wash basin, plumbing roughed-in, tile floor — fully self-contained.
  • Partition wall: Split a 20 ft or 40 ft cabin into two separate rooms.
  • Exterior paint: Primer plus two coats in your specified colour.

All specifications are confirmed in writing before manufacturing begins. No changes after production starts.

Our Credentials

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and was incorporated as a private limited company in 2019. We hold:

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (Certificate E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health and Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC Registration: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT Recognition: DIPP56005
  • GST: 29ABBCS7101B1ZR

More than 500 projects completed. Structural warranty 5 years. Finishing elements 1–2 years. Engineered service life 20–25 years.

A manufacturer holding three ISO certifications and NSIC registration is accountable in a way that an unregistered reseller is not. Every cabin we build is traceable back to the production batch, the material lot, and the dispatch date. That matters when you are buying for a SAIL vendor location or an industrial estate where quality documentation may be required.

Delivery to Salem

  • Dispatch point: Gopasandra, Sarjapura Hubli Road, Bangalore 560099
  • Route: NH 44 south through Krishnagiri, Dharmapuri, to Salem
  • Distance: approximately 340 km
  • Transit: 4 to 5 days from dispatch to your Salem address

The cabin travels on a flatbed truck. At your delivery point you need a crane, telehandler, or JCB capable of lifting the cabin clear of the truck bed. We confirm the cabin's weight and dimensions with your delivery note so you can book the right equipment. A 10 ft × 8 ft standard security cabin weighs roughly 800 to 1,000 kg. A fitted 20 ft × 10 ft office with toilet can reach 2,200 kg.

No RCC foundation needed for temporary use. A levelled hard surface — compacted murrum, paver block, or existing concrete — is sufficient. If you need anchor bolt fixing for a semi-permanent installation, tell us at order stage and we design the base frame with fixing plates.

We deliver to SIPCOT Mecheri (636453), Salem Steel Plant area, SIDCO estate Salem, and all Salem city and Salem district addresses. If your site is at an industrial estate that requires vehicle entry permits, let us know the procedure in advance. We coordinate with your site supervisor directly.

Our MS porta cabin is the most common model ordered for Salem contractor sites. For multi-unit requirements — labour colonies, site office clusters — our full porta cabin products range has the options.

Pricing

No fixed prices. Every cabin is built to your specification so every price is specific to your order. The cost of a basic 10 ft × 8 ft watchman cabin with no electrical work is fundamentally different from a 20 ft × 10 ft site office with PUF upgrade, AC provision, partition, false ceiling, and attached toilet.

What goes into your price:

  • Cabin size
  • Panel type (standard PUF or cement fibre board)
  • Fit-out level — bare structure, wired, or fully fitted
  • Customisation items (doors, windows, toilet, partition)
  • Freight — Salem is 340 km from our factory, which is reflected in the transport charge. We include it as a separate line item in your quotation.

Call or send an enquiry with your size and delivery address. Written quotation with full line-item breakup returned within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you supply porta cabins to the SIPCOT Mecheri industrial estate?

Yes. We deliver to SIPCOT Mecheri (PIN 636453) and all industrial estate addresses in Salem district. If your unit requires vehicle entry authorisation, share the contact details and gate procedure when placing the order. We coordinate the delivery vehicle arrival with your site team.

How should I prepare my Salem site for cabin delivery and placement?

Clear and level a footprint slightly larger than the cabin size. Confirm overhead clearance — no low power lines or cables above the placement zone. Book a crane or JCB rated for the cabin weight (we provide this with the delivery note). Arrange gate-pass for our delivery vehicle if your site is inside an industrial estate. Installation takes 2 to 3 hours once the crane is on-site.

Salem gets very hot in summer. Will the cabin be comfortable to work in?

A standard 40mm PUF panel cabin provides meaningful thermal insulation. For direct-sun sites in Salem's peak summer (April to June), we recommend the insulation upgrade plus AC provision. A 1.5-tonne AC unit paired with an insulated cabin and a false ceiling will maintain a workable temperature even at 40°C outside.

Can you supply multiple porta cabins for a large Salem project?

Yes. We handle multi-unit orders for labour colonies, site office clusters, and permanent installations. Multi-unit orders are planned as a set — cabin sizes, layout, spacing, and shared services (power, water) — and dispatched in coordinated batches. Call us with the project scope and we plan the supply schedule.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For porta cabins in Salem, SIPCOT Mecheri, or anywhere in Salem district:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. If you prefer the enquiry form, mention your cabin size, intended use, and Salem delivery address.
